August 26, 2026

From the preceding month, the PCE price index for July increased 0.2 percent. Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index increased 0.3 percent.

From the same month one year ago, the PCE price index increased 2.6 percent. Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index increased 2.9 percent from one year ago.
